createdFor: NL-to-SQL chatbot v1 (schema RAG) — PO/WO/Payment/Indent/Ledger + MRN/Store Inward

database.name: MaterialProcessing
database.relatedDatabase: loginentry (users/rights; cross-db as loginentry..loginrights — out of v1 allowlist unless needed for email/name lookup)

globalRules: Chatbot may only generate SELECT queries.
Always use TOP or another row limit unless the question is a COUNT aggregate.
Prefer exact status filter status = 'Pending' for pending work.
Approved statuses are often 'Approved' OR values like 'Approved by <username>'. Prefer status LIKE 'Approved%' when counting approved.
Rejected may appear as 'Rejected', 'Rejected by <username>', or rarely 'reject'.
SQL Server identifiers are case-insensitive under typical CI collation; column casing below matches live sys.columns.
Do not use *_temp, *_TEST, *_Delete, *_afterMail, or other non-allowlisted objects.

Ledger transaction statements in the portal use stored procedure sp_ac_LedgerSummary_BankRecoDate (not a simple SELECT). Chatbot SELECT scope for Ledger domain is FactoryInfo / LedgerMaster / CommonLedgerMaster. Avoid heavy views like vw_LedgerSummary unless explicitly needed and TOP-limited.
FactoryInfo.Name joins to LedgerMaster.CompanyName. Factory groups use FactoryInfo.GroupName. Portal company id uses FactoryInfo.SrNo (aka srno).

COLUMN NAME TRAP: FactoryInfo PAN column is PermanentAccountNo (NOT PANNo). LedgerMaster/CommonLedgerMaster PAN column is PANNo. Never select PANNo from FactoryInfo. FactoryInfo GST preferred column is NewGSTNo (also has GST).
GOVERNANCE: Ledger/account groups are LedgerMaster.Under (use SELECT DISTINCT Under ...). Do NOT use LedgerGroupMaster — that table is empty/unused for user-facing group lists.
GOVERNANCE: LedgerOpeningBalance table is EMPTY (0 rows). For opening/pending balance questions use LedgerMaster.Openingbalance and LedgerMaster.PendingBalance. Never query LedgerOpeningBalance.

MRN / store inward: prefer Vw_StoreInwards or vw_MRNList for user questions. Header key SrNo joins StoreInwardsPayment.SrNo = StoreInwards.SrNo. MRN number is MRNo / MRno. BillPaymentEntry.MRNno joins StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo. Prefer TOP 50 — StoreInwards and WareHouseInwards are large. Skip *_old,*_GPL3,*_delete clones. Columns with spaces in vw_MRNToBillPayment (e.g. [Challan Date], [Basic Amount], [MRN User]) must be bracket-quoted.

GOVERNANCE (MRN): When user says 'for company X' / 'company X' / 'under X Limited' on material receipts, filter CompanyName = X. PartyName/SupplierName is the VENDOR/supplier only — use those when user says vendor, supplier, or party. Do not put the receiving company into PartyName.

COLUMN NAME TRAP (MRN): There is NO column named MRDate anywhere in MRN objects. Vw_StoreInwards / StoreInwardsPayment date columns are BillDate, GateInwardDate, SysDate, ChallanDate — never MRDate. vw_MRNList and BillPaymentEntry use MRNDate (spelled MRNDate, not MRDate). For 'recent' receipts ORDER BY BillDate or GateInwardDate DESC on Vw_StoreInwards.

GOVERNANCE (MRN names): Names like 'Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase' are PartyName (vendor), not CompanyName. Receiving companies look like 'Plastene Polyfilms Limited' / 'Plastene India Limited'. If the question asks for receipts 'for <name> with party and bill', treat <name> as PartyName when it is a vendor-style name (often ends with -Purchase).

GOVERNANCE (MRN payment): For 'payment against MRN / was payment raised / how much for material receipt X', prefer BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = X (select PaymentNo, PaymentAmount, BillNo, UTRno, status, isPaid). vw_MRNToBillPayment is line-grain and often has NULL PaymentNo on unpaid lines — NEVER conclude 'no payment' from null rows alone. If using the view: WHERE MRno = X AND PaymentNo IS NOT NULL, SELECT DISTINCT PaymentNo, PaymentAmount.

GOVERNANCE (receipt by bill): For 'receipts linked to bill number X' / 'material receipt for bill X', filter Vw_StoreInwards.BillNo or StoreInwardsPayment.BillNo = X. Do NOT use BillPaymentEntry.BillNo for finding store receipts — that bill field is the payment-request bill and often does not match supplier bill numbers like PPL/D/540.

objects.purpose: Standard (non-HOD) purchase order approval queue. One row per approver assignment on a PO. Used by the PO approval portal for pending/approved/rejected PO workflows.
objects.primaryKeyHint: TransId (identity-like unique row id). Business key is (PoNo, ApprovalName).
objects.statusNotes: Exact pending value: 'Pending'. Approved rows are often 'Approved' or 'Approved by <user>'. Rejected: 'Rejected' or 'Rejected by <user>'. Rare legacy value '0' exists.

columns.name: PoNo
columns.meaning: Purchase order number; joins to PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode and Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode

columns.name: ApprovalName
columns.meaning: Approver username assigned to act on this PO

columns.name: PODate
columns.meaning: PO date shown in pending lists

columns.name: ApprovalDate
columns.meaning: When this approver acted (null while Pending)

columns.name: TransId
columns.meaning: Unique transaction/row id for this approval assignment

joins.note: Vendor FirmName, line items; some old POs may not match
Same PO can also appear in HOD queue; portal unions both for pending

exampleQuestions: How many POs are pending?

objects.embeddingText: Table ApprovePO. Domain: Purchase order (PO) approval. Purpose: tracks each approver assignment on a purchase order for the standard (non-HOD) approval queue used by the PO approval portal. Columns: PoNo (PO number), ApprovalName (approver username), status (Pending, Approved, Approved by user, Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, TransId (unique row id). Joins: ApprovePO.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode = Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode; ApprovalName = POAllocation.username. Synonyms: pending PO, purchase order approval, PO waiting, standard PO queue. Filter pending with status = 'Pending'. For approved counts use status LIKE 'Approved%'.

objects.purpose: HOD-level purchase order approval queue. Same shape as ApprovePO but for HOD authority path. Portal pending PO API unions ApprovePO and ApprovePOHOD.

joins.note: Related standard approvers on same PO

synonyms: head of department purchase order approval
exampleQuestions: How many HOD PO approvals are pending?
Pending POs in HOD queue for user X
objects.embeddingText: Table ApprovePOHOD. Domain: Purchase order HOD approval. Purpose: HOD authority purchase order approval assignments; portal unions this with ApprovePO for pending POs. Columns: PoNo, ApprovalName, status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, transid. Joins: PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode = Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: HOD PO approval, head of department PO pending, ApprovePOHOD. Pending filter: status = 'Pending'.

objects.purpose: Work order approval queue. PoNo here is the work-order / purchase code identifier used like a PO number in the portal. Pending WO list joins PurchasePayment for TotalAmount.
objects.statusNotes: Pending exact: 'Pending'. Many 'Approved by <user>' variants plus 'Approved' and 'Rejected'.

joins.note: Amount/company; portal uses this for pending WO totals

exampleQuestions: How many work orders are pending?
Show pending work orders for user X with amounts
objects.embeddingText: Table ApproveWorkOrder. Domain: Work order (WO) approval. Purpose: approval assignments for work orders; PoNo is the work order code. Columns: PoNo, ApprovalName, status (Pending/Approved by user/Rejected), PODate, ApprovalDate, Transid. Joins: ApproveWorkOrder.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode for TotalAmount and CompanyName. Synonyms: pending work order, WO approval, job work order. Pending filter: status = 'Pending'.

objects.purpose: Indent (purchase requisition) approval queue. IndentNo is the parent indent; IndentSubCode is the line-level code. Portal groups pending by IndentNo; approve updates by IndentSubCode.

columns.name: IndentNo
columns.meaning: Parent indent number (e.g. PIL/22-23/RWM00019). Joins to Vw_StoreDeptt.Expr1

columns.name: IndentSubCode
columns.meaning: Line/sub indent code (e.g. .../01). Joins to ItemInfo.code — NOT IndentNo

joins.note: Validated: join on IndentSubCode, not IndentNo
Portal indent details use Expr1 = IndentNo; line code is Vw_StoreDeptt.code

exampleQuestions: How many indents are pending?

objects.embeddingText: Table ApproveIndent. Domain: Indent / purchase requisition approval. Purpose: approver assignments on indents. Columns: IndentNo (parent indent), IndentSubCode (line code), ApprovalName, Status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), IndentDate, ApprovalDate, transId. Critical joins: IndentSubCode = ItemInfo.code; IndentNo = Vw_StoreDeptt.Expr1. Do not join ItemInfo.code to IndentNo. Synonyms: pending indent, purchase requisition, store indent approval. Pending filter: Status = 'Pending'.

objects.purpose: PO / work-order header commercial data: total amount, company, currency, delivery, payment terms, taxes. Not the bill-payment request table. Used as amount/company source for PO and WO pending lists.
objects.statusNotes: No approval status column; use Approve* tables for pending/approved.

columns.name: TotalAmount
columns.meaning: Header total amount used in pending filters

columns.name: Payment
columns.meaning: Payment terms text on PO (not bill payment)

columns.name: PoSignal
columns.meaning: PO signal / status flag used in ERP

columns.name: amendmentPoNo
columns.meaning: Related amendment PO number if any

objects.embeddingText: Table PurchasePayment. Domain: PO and work-order header commercial data. Purpose: TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, delivery and payment terms for a PurchaseCode. Not bill/vendor payment requests (those are BillPayment*). Columns include PurchaseCode (PK), TotalAmount, CompanyName, Currency, LoginName, TypeOfPO, DepttName, deliverydate, Payment terms text, PoSignal, taxes/discounts. Joins: PurchaseCode = ApprovePO.PoNo / ApproveWorkOrder.PoNo / Vw_PurchaseOrder.PurchaseCode / FinalQuotation.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: PO amount, PO header total, purchase order value.

objects.purpose: Rich PO line/vendor view used for PO details and PDF/display. One or more rows per PurchaseCode (line items). Prefer this for vendor name (FirmName), item description, qty, rate. Prefer PurchasePayment.TotalAmount for header total when listing approvals.
objects.primaryKeyHint: No single PK; grain is typically line-level under PurchaseCode (transid/RowNum present).
objects.statusNotes: Not an approval status table. Use ApprovePO/ApprovePOHOD for approval state.

columns.name: TotalAmount
columns.meaning: Header-related total on view (portal often uses PurchasePayment.TotalAmount instead)

exampleQuestions: Show details of PO X

objects.embeddingText: View Vw_PurchaseOrder. Domain: Purchase order line and vendor details. Purpose: display PO items, FirmName vendor, qty, rate, GST; used by portal PO details. Key columns: PurchaseCode, FirmName, ItemDesc, ItemCode, Qty, Rate, Total, PendingQty, DepttName, CompanyName, Currency, deliverydate, VendorCode, hsncode, tax fields. Join: PurchaseCode = ApprovePO.PoNo = PurchasePayment.PurchaseCode. Synonyms: PO details, PO line items, vendor name on PO. Not for approval status — use ApprovePO.

objects.purpose: Quoted/ordered line items tied to a PurchaseCode (PO). Used when building PO PDFs and item-level quote rates. Overlaps conceptually with Vw_PurchaseOrder lines; prefer Vw_PurchaseOrder for portal-style details unless quote-specific fields are needed.
exampleQuestions: Show quotation lines for PO X

objects.embeddingText: Table FinalQuotation. Domain: PO quotation / ordered lines. Purpose: item rates and quantities for a PurchaseCode used in PO documents. Columns: PurchaseCode, FirmName, ItemCode, ItemDesc, Qty, Rate, Discount, Total, Unit, StoreCode, SubCode, HSNCODE, GST percents, transid. Join on PurchaseCode to PurchasePayment and Vw_PurchaseOrder. Synonyms: final quotation, PO quote lines. Prefer Vw_PurchaseOrder for general PO detail questions.

objects.purpose: Maps approver usernames to company, department, authority level and amount limits for PO approval routing. Used to determine who can approve and at what authority.
exampleQuestions: What companies can user X approve POs for?

objects.embeddingText: Table POAllocation. Domain: PO approval authority mapping. Purpose: username to CompanyName, Deptt, authority level, POAmount/ItemAmount/PartyAmount limits. Columns: username, CompanyName, POAmount, ItemAmount, PartyAmount, NewVendor, NewItem, Deptt, srno, authority. Join username to ApprovePO.ApprovalName / ApproveWorkOrder.ApprovalName. Synonyms: PO approver allocation, authority limits, who can approve. Table name may appear as poallocation in older SQL.

objects.embeddingText: Table BillPaymentHODApproval. Domain: Bill payment approval. Purpose: pending/approved payment request assignments for approvers; main pending-payments table in the portal. Columns: paymentNo (join key), BillNo, MRNo, PartyName (vendor), PaymentAmount, PaymentDate, LoginName (requester), ApprovalName, Status (Pending/Approved/Rejected), ApprovalDate, Comment, transId. Join: paymentNo = BillPaymentEntry.PaymentNo. Synonyms: pending payment, bill payment approval, vendor payment request, PRQ. Pending filter: Status = 'Pending'.

objects.purpose: Bill payment request header/details: company, vendor, bill, MRN, amounts, bank, UTR, paid flags. Use with BillPaymentHODApproval for pending approver queues; query this alone for payment detail by PaymentNo.
objects.primaryKeyHint: PaymentNo (with BillNo/MRNno also NOT NULL in schema — treat PaymentNo as request id)
objects.statusNotes: Entry-level status exists (Pending/Approved/Rejected) but portal pending list is driven by BillPaymentHODApproval.Status.

objects.embeddingText: Table BillPaymentEntry. Domain: Bill payment request details. Purpose: company, vendor, bill, MRN, amounts, bank, UTR, isPaid for a PaymentNo. Columns: PaymentNo, CompanyName, VendorName, BillNo, BillDate, MRNno (join to StoreInwardsPayment.MRNo / material receipt number), MRNDate, BillAmount, PaymentAmount, PaymentDate, status, UTRno, isPaid, IsCancel. PREFERRED for 'payment raised against MRN X / how much' => SELECT PaymentNo, MRNno, BillNo, PaymentAmount, BillAmount, status, isPaid FROM BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = 'RM 269'. Join PaymentNo = BillPaymentHODApproval.paymentNo. Synonyms: payment details, bill payment entry, UTR, vendor bill, payment against material receipt. Pending approver queue is primarily BillPaymentHODApproval.

objects.purpose: Payment approval history / snapshot rows including ApprovalName, ApprovalDate, comment. Portal GetPaymentHistory reads from this table (not only HOD table).
objects.primaryKeyHint: Composite-ish on PaymentNo + BillNo + MRNno + approval fields; no single documented PK beyond business keys.

Purpose: historical approval rows with ApprovalName, ApprovalDate, comment, status for a PaymentNo; used by portal payment history API. Join PaymentNo to BillPaymentEntry and BillPaymentHODApproval.paymentNo. Synonyms: payment approval history, payment comments, who approved payment.

objects.purpose: Maps payment approvers to company, department, authority, and ishod flag. Used during payment approve to resolve authority level.

objects.purpose: Indent line item master details. code is the indent line/subcode (matches ApproveIndent.IndentSubCode), not the parent IndentNo.

Synonyms: indent items, requisition lines, ItemInfo.

objects.statusNotes: IndentApproved is view flag; approval workflow status is on ApproveIndent.Status.

objects.embeddingText: Table FactoryInfo. Domain: Ledger / company master. Purpose: companies and factories for accounting and ledger summary. Columns: Name (company name), SrNo (company id), GroupName (group), Address, NewGSTNo (company GSTIN), GST (legacy), PermanentAccountNo (company PAN — NOT named PANNo; FactoryInfo has no PANNo column), LedgerOpeningDate, IndentCode, GroupTag. Join: FactoryInfo.Name = LedgerMaster.CompanyName. Synonyms: company list, factory list, unit master, company GST, company PAN, company group. For company GST/PAN questions select only from FactoryInfo using NewGSTNo and PermanentAccountNo.

objects.embeddingText: Table LedgerMaster (also queried as ledgermaster). Domain: Ledger / chart of accounts. Purpose: party, vendor, bank and GL ledger master per CompanyName. Columns: CompanyName, LedgerName, Under (parent account/ledger GROUP — use DISTINCT Under for ledger groups; never empty LedgerGroupMaster), Openingbalance (opening balance — use for opening-balance questions), PendingBalance (pending/outstanding — use for pending balance questions; LedgerOpeningBalance table is EMPTY do not query it), Category, MainCategory, GSTNo, NewGSTNo, PANNo (ledger/party PAN only — company PAN is FactoryInfo.PermanentAccountNo), BankAccNo, BankName, IFSCCode, PaymentTerms, email, ContactNo, MSMENumber, LVendorCode, IsHold. Join CompanyName = FactoryInfo.Name. Synonyms: ledger list, party master, opening balance, pending balance, ledger outstanding, LedgerOpeningBalance (redirect here), ledger groups, account groups. For pending/opening bills/balances: SELECT LedgerName, Openingbalance, PendingBalance FROM LedgerMaster WHERE CompanyName = .... Do not use for full voucher/ledger statement SP. Avoid vw_LedgerSummary.

objects.purpose: Alternate/common ledger master similar to LedgerMaster (shared/group chart). Prefer LedgerMaster for portal-aligned company ledger lists unless the question explicitly says common ledger master.

columns.name: PANNo

exampleQuestions: List common ledger master entries for a company
objects.embeddingText: Table CommonLedgerMaster. Domain: Ledger. Purpose: common/shared ledger master similar to LedgerMaster with CompanyName, LedgerName, Under, balances, GST/PAN/bank, LSTATUS. Prefer LedgerMaster for normal portal ledger questions. Synonyms: common ledger master, shared chart of accounts.

objects.embeddingText: Table StoreInwardsPayment. Domain: MRN / store inward header. Purpose: MRNo, SrNo, CompanyName (receiving company), PartyName/SupplierName (VENDOR only — e.g. Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase), BillNo, BillDate (NO MRDate column), BillAMount, ChallanNo, Gate_Inward_No, PONo, IndentNo. Join SrNo to StoreInwards; MRNo to BillPaymentEntry.MRNno. Synonyms: MRN, material receipt, store inward, GRN, goods receipt, find by bill number. Prefer Vw_StoreInwards for combined questions.

objects.purpose: MRN / store inward LINE ITEMS: item received quantities against an inward SrNo (and often a PO). Large table (~333k rows) — always use TOP / date filters.

Purpose: ItemCode, ItemName, RecdQty, AcceptedQty, OrderQty, PendingQty, Rate, Amount, PONo per SrNo. Join SrNo to StoreInwardsPayment for MRNo/party/bill. Large table — use TOP 50. Synonyms: MRN items, received materials, store inward lines.

objects.purpose: Combined store inward / MRN view (header + lines). Best default for 'show this MRN' / 'what was received' questions. Includes MRNo, PartyName, BillNo, item qtys, gate inward, GST fields.

columns.name: CompanyName

objects.embeddingText: View Vw_StoreInwards. Domain: MRN / store inward combined details. Preferred view for material receipt questions. Columns: SrNo, MRNo, PONo, CompanyName (receiving company), PartyName (VENDOR — e.g. Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase is a PartyName), BillNo, BillDate, GateInwardDate, SysDate, ItemName, ItemCode, RecdQty, AcceptedQty, OrderQty, PendingQty, Rate, Amount, Deptt, IndentNo, GateInwardNo, VendorGST, MRNStatus, LoginName. NO column MRDate — use BillDate/GateInwardDate/SysDate. Synonyms: goods receipt, GRN, material received, receipts by bill number. Example: Find receipts linked to bill number PPL/D/540 => WHERE BillNo = 'PPL/D/540' on THIS view (not BillPaymentEntry). Example: receipts for Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase => WHERE PartyName = '...'. Example: for company Oswal Extrusion Limited pending qty => CompanyName + PendingQty > 0. Always TOP 50.

objects.purpose: MRN listing view for browsing receipts by company/party/date with item lines and bill/challan/gate inward fields.

columns.name: CompanyName
columns.meaning: Receiving company — use for 'for company X'

objects.embeddingText: View vw_MRNList. Domain: MRN listing. Purpose: list material receipts with CompanyName (receiving company), Partyname (vendor only), MRNDate (spelled MRNDate — never invent MRDate), MRno, BillNo, item quantities, GateInwardNo. Synonyms: MRN list, material receipt list, browse MRNs, recent goods receipts. For company filter use CompanyName; for vendor like Plastene Polyfilms Ltd-Purchase use Partyname. Use TOP 50. Column MRno is the MRN number.

objects.purpose: Bridge view from MRN/store inward to bill payment request: shows MRno, bill, party, and PaymentNo/PaymentAmount/UTRno when a payment exists. Use for 'was this MRN paid?' / 'payment against MRN' questions.
objects.primaryKeyHint: Line grain linking MRno to PaymentNo

columns.name: PaymentNo

columns.name: PaymentAmount

objects.embeddingText: View vw_MRNToBillPayment. Domain: MRN linked to bill payment. Purpose: connect material receipt MRno to PaymentNo, PaymentAmount, UTRno, BillNo, Partyname. CRITICAL: view is LINE grain — many rows have NULL PaymentNo even when payments exist for that MRN. For 'was payment raised against MRN RM 269 and for how much' prefer BillPaymentEntry WHERE MRNno = 'RM 269'. If using this view: SELECT DISTINCT PaymentNo, PaymentAmount WHERE MRno = 'RM 269' AND PaymentNo IS NOT NULL. Never treat a NULL PaymentNo row as proof of no payment. Synonyms: payment against MRN, was MRN paid, UTR for MRN, PRQ for material receipt. Bracket spaced columns: [Challan Date], [Basic Amount], [MRN User].
